name: Akki Battle Squad
oracle_text: Whenever one or more modified creatures you control attack, untap all modified creatures you control. After this phase, there is an additional combat phase. This ability triggers only once each turn. (Equipment, Auras you control, and counters are modifications.)
blocked_sentences: Whenever one or more modified creatures you control attack, untap all modified creatures you control. After this phase, there is an additional combat phase. This ability triggers only once each turn.

needs.what: the `modified` key (700.9: has a counter, is equipped, or is enchanted by an Aura its controller controls) honoured in a trigger `filter`, so a batched `attacks` trigger can fire on "one or more modified creatures you control attack"
needs.why_existing_wont_do: `modified` exists in selector_keys (so the untap effect is expressible) but not in TRIGGER_FILTER_KEYS, which the loader enforces in `triggers.validate_trigger_filter`. An `any_of` of `has_counters` and `enchanted_by` misses the Equipment limb: the trigger filter's `attached` means attached to the ability source, and `equipped` is not a trigger filter key, so a creature modified only by Equipment would not trigger it
